# Junco Reader

> Junco Reader is a free browser tool that reads PDFs, Markdown, and pasted text out loud.
> Narration runs entirely on-device using the Kokoro text-to-speech model — documents are
> never uploaded to a server. No account required.

## Key facts
- Platform: web (any modern browser with WebAssembly support).
- Status: live, free to use.
- Categories: text to speech, PDF reader, accessibility tool, on-device AI.
- Differentiators: on-device Kokoro TTS (not a cloud API), no account or upload, works with
  PDF/TXT/Markdown/pasted text, one-time optional voice model download for offline use.
- Companion product: Junco, an iOS app that turns email newsletters into a daily podcast.

## Not to be confused with
- The dark-eyed junco (a North American songbird).
- Junco Capital (a finance company).

## Links
- Junco Reader: https://read.tryjunco.com
- Junco (iOS newsletter podcast app): https://www.tryjunco.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/junco-newsletter-reader/id6761576928
